gen_risks.description: Technical risk - Failure to develop and implement new IT systems effectively
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide technical assistance and training to ADISA and other implementing agencies to ensure they have the necessary capacity and expertise to develop and implement new IT systems effectively.
gen_risks.evidence: Seven institutions encompassed by the proposed project have no IT system in place.

gen_risks.description: Financial risk - Mismanagement of funds or inadequate financial planning
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide financial management training and support to ADISA and other implementing agencies, and ensure that financial planning and monitoring are robust and transparent.
gen_risks.evidence: The overall financial management risk is rated as Substantial.

gen_risks.description: Schedule risk - Delays in implementation or achievement of milestones
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a detailed project schedule and monitor progress regularly, and provide support and resources to ADISA and other implementing agencies to ensure they can meet deadlines and milestones.
gen_risks.evidence: The compressed implementation timeline is a potential risk.

gen_risks.description: Stakeholder risk - Lack of coordination or communication among stakeholders
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a stakeholder engagement plan and ensure that all stakeholders are informed and involved in the project's implementation, and provide support and resources to facilitate communication and coordination among stakeholders.
gen_risks.evidence: The project involves multiple government agencies and stakeholders, and coordination among them will be crucial for success.

gen_risks.description: Political_regulatory risk - Changes in government policies or regulations that affect the project's implementation or outcomes
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor changes in government policies and regulations, and ensure that the project is aligned with any changes or updates.
gen_risks.evidence: The project is aligned with the Government's program, and any changes in government policies or priorities could impact the project.

gen_risks.description: Environmental risk - Environmental impacts of the construction of the new building for the Citizen Service Center
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensure that the construction of the new building is carried out in accordance with environmental regulations and standards, and that any environmental impacts are mitigated or minimized.
gen_risks.evidence: The project will not directly finance the building, but will disburse upon fulfilling DLIs linked to the provision of services in the one-stop shop.

gen_risks.description: Organizational risk - Lack of capacity or expertise within ADISA and other implementing agencies
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide training and support to ADISA and other implementing agencies to ensure they have the necessary capacity and expertise to implement the project effectively.
gen_risks.evidence: ADISA is a new agency, and its capacity to implement the project is still being developed.

gen_risks.description: External risk - Impact of external factors, such as economic conditions and technological advancements, on the project's implementation or outcomes
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor external factors and ensure that the project is adaptable and resilient to any changes or updates.
gen_risks.evidence: The project's success will depend on various external factors, including economic conditions and technological advancements.

gt_risks.description: Institutional capacity poses challenges to delivering the reform effort, despite very high leadership commitment and fast-paced GoA initiation of reforms.
gt_risks.mitigation: The Project Preparation Facility (PPF) is designed to assist capacity building for the implementing agency; the TA part of the loan continues building capacity to deliver, addressing the most pressing capacity needs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risks related to the new form of financial instrument used in Albania.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the fiduciary risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk, named alongside the fiduciary risk as being addressed by the same TA support (fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU); not separately elaborated beyond this.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the technical design risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risks arising from inter-agency coordination.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by strong emphasis on coordination mechanisms in the design of the operation.

gt_risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance to enhanced transparency and simplification of administrative processes.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated in part through high-level leadership and engagement, and through citizen feedback arrangements that help pinpoint poor performance and corruption.

gt_risks.description: Political cycle risk from elections coming up in 2017, which could disrupt reform continuity and government commitment.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by making early progress in showing results and ensuring a broad constituency of support for the project's objectives and activities among the leadership of participating institutions and service users.
